about: Synthetic fixture of the consultation pipeline's e2e journeys (SAL-10): a German-speaking patient and a Bosnian-speaking practitioner. Written for the tests, spoken by no one: each line is a generated tone the fake speech engine maps to its text (pkg/stt/stttest), its translations and the suggestions and fields are the fake model's answers (pkg/llm/llmtest). Every text is placeholder wording, labelled as such, not clinical content and not reviewed.
